title: Invertibility of the specified tensor-to-limit map
statement: With X,A,I,C,H,phi as in [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-projection-maps], let N be a finite C-module. The concrete map completedConstantComparisonMap, whose finite projections were constructed and proved compatible independently of finiteness, is an isomorphism. This statement supplies only invertibility: it neither constructs the map nor asserts any naturality or completed-scalar identities.

proof.text: The completion C is Noetherian, so the finite module N admits a finite free presentation C^m -> C^n -> N -> 0.

Use the actual additive realization and completion functors and their natural comparison. For a finite free module, its coordinate projections p_i and inclusions q_i satisfy sum(p_i q_i)=id. If the rank-one comparison is invertible, the sum G(p_i) alpha_C^(-1) F(q_i) is inverse to alpha_(C^n); naturality and additivity verify both composites. This also treats n=0.

Realization preserves finite colimits, and completion preserves the cokernel of the presentation by right exactness for finite modules. The comparison on its two finite free vertices is invertible by the preceding coordinate calculation. Apply the natural-transformation colimit comparison to this cokernel cocone, obtaining invertibility on N. Its component is definitionally the fixed completedConstantComparisonMap.

proof_origin.place: Finite-presentation argument of Tag 093K, applied to the natural comparison and its actual cokernel diagrams; right exactness is the sectionwise calculation of Tags 093J--093M and More on Algebra Tag 0912

theorem completedConstantComparisonMap_isIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (φ : adicLisseConstantRing X (AdicCompletion I A) ⟶ adicLisseCompletedRing X I)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X I) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1)).toRingHom))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion I A))
    (_hN : Module.Finite (AdicCompletion I A) N) :
    IsIso (completedConstantComparisonMap X I φ hφ N)
